mainEntity.name: Do I need to repair every damaged thing before selling or renting out my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not need to repair everything. A practical approach is to fix items with strong return, price around larger defects, and skip cosmetic work that will not change buyer or renter interest much. In Denver-area markets, targeted repair usually makes more sense than doing a full remodel before listing.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Focus on repairs that improve safety, photos, inspections, and renter or buyer confidence. Leave low-impact items alone if the cost does not match the likely return.
